title: 3.3 rc1 stop insulin dosing below bg value doesn't work with "tdd based sens ratio for basal and target" enabled
symptom: With 'tdd based sens ratio for basal and target' enabled, basal insulin delivery continues even when blood glucose is below the threshold, whereas disabling that setting immediately stops basal as expected.
cause: The thread does not definitively establish a root cause. A participant suggests that the modification to ISF calculation might cause the oref1 algorithm to calculate values higher than target, leading to insulin dosing, but this is speculative.
fix: The user decided to leave the 'tdd based sens ratio' setting off to achieve expected behavior on low bg values. No other fix is provided.
settings_changed: tdd based sens ratio for basal and target → off
evidence_quote: Turning of "  tdd based sens ratio... “immediately stopt basal as expected based on bg level.
